name: PMET Resources Inc.
summary: PMET Resources Inc. engages in the identification, acquisition of exploration, development, and evaluation of mineral properties in the United States and Canada. The company explores for gold, copper, silver, lithium, caesium, and tantalum deposits. Its flagship property is the Shaakichiuwaanaan project, comprising 463 claims totaling 23,710 hectares located in the Eeyou Istchee James Bay region of Québec, Canada. The company was formerly known as Patriot Battery Metals Inc. and changed its name to PMET Resources Inc. in September 2025. PMET Resources Inc. was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Montreal, Canada.
